tagline: Innovating medicine to improve and extend life
hero_kpi_rationale: Revenue from the top drug is the primary growth driver at Novartis, particularly driven by Cosentyx and Pluvicto, which benefit from strong adoption dynamics in high-potential segments such as auto-immunity and targeted oncology.

kpis.name: Top Drug Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated by the company's best-selling drug.
kpis.description: Cosentyx (treatment for psoriasis and spondyloarthritis) continues to dominate the portfolio, with sustained growth despite competitive pressures.
kpis.signal: Cosentyx remains a cornerstone despite competition.

kpis.name: Advanced R&D Pipeline Phases
kpis.explanation: Number of drugs in phase 3 clinical trials, the final stage before approval.
kpis.description: Novartis maintains a strong pipeline with several candidates in phase 3, particularly in targeted therapies and gene treatments.
kpis.signal: Robust pipeline in oncology and rare diseases.

kpis.name: Operating Margin (Core)
kpis.explanation: Profit margin after operating costs, excluding exceptional items.
kpis.description: Operating margin is improving due to better cost management and growth in high-margin products.

kpis.name: R&D Investments (% of Revenue)
kpis.explanation: Share of research and development expenses in revenue.
kpis.description: Novartis continues to invest heavily in R&D to fuel its future pipeline, particularly in oncology and innovative therapies.
kpis.signal: Strong commitment to innovation despite margin pressure.

kpis.name: Free Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Cash generated after investments and ongoing expenses.
kpis.description: FCF is increasing due to revenue growth and disciplined capital management. Free cash flow increased by USD 1.3 billion in 2025.
kpis.signal: Strong cash-generating machine to fund dividends and buybacks.

kpis.name: Specialty Revenue Segment
kpis.explanation: Revenue from vaccines and specialized treatments (rare diseases, oncology).
kpis.description: Specialty products such as Pluvicto and Kesimpta show strong growth momentum.

kpis.name: Recent FDA Approval
kpis.explanation: Drug recently approved by the FDA, with recent launch.
kpis.description: In 2025, Pluvicto received FDA approval (as well as from Japan and China) for use prior to chemotherapy in patients with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer who are PSMA-positive, significantly expanding its patient base.
kpis.signal: Pluvicto approved for earlier use, opening a new market.

kpis.name: Notable Pipeline Innovations
kpis.explanation: Recent approvals of innovative products from the development pipeline.
kpis.description: In 2025, Novartis obtained approval for four major innovations: Rhapsido (first oral BTK inhibitor for chronic spontaneous urticaria), earlier approval of Pluvicto before chemotherapy, Coartem Baby (first malaria treatment for newborns approved by Swissmedic), and Itvisma (first gene replacement therapy for spinal muscular atrophy in children aged 2 and older).
kpis.signal: Dynamic clinical pipeline with multiple major approvals in 2025.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions.
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + buybacks (2021-2025) in billions USD. Source yfinance cashflow.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du résultat net redistribuée. >80 % = potentiellement non soutenable.

risks.title: Regulatory
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict regulations in the healthcare sector, which can impact its operations. Changes in healthcare policies can also affect sales and profits.

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The healthcare market is highly competitive, with many players present. The company must innovate and differentiate to maintain its position.

risks.title: Innovation
risks.score_rationale: Innovation is crucial for the company, which must develop new products and technologies to remain competitive. Failures in innovation can have serious consequences.

risks.title: Operational Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to operational risks, such as supply chain failures or product quality issues. These risks can impact production and sales.

risks.title: Geopolitical
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a complex geopolitical environment, with risks related to political and economic changes in the countries where it operates. These risks can impact sales and profits.
